headline: Bring AirTouch 4 zones into Home Assistant
intro: AirTouch 4 connects Home Assistant to supported Ducted Air Conditioning Systems. The integration supports AirTouch 4 controllers with Individual Temperature Control (ITC) modules and creates a climate entity for each temperature-controlled zone.
highlights: Control a Ducted Air Conditioning System using an AirTouch 4 controller
Support is limited to AirTouch 4 controllers with Individual Temperature Control (ITC) modules
Get a climate entity for each temperature-controlled zone

flow.title: Set up AirTouch 4
stages: Open Settings > Devices & services in Home Assistant
Choose Add integration and select AirTouch 4
Follow the on-screen instructions to complete setup
